about: Divergences CI expects to see with the versions pinned in ci/requirements.txt, sightings/package-lock.json, runners/go/go.sum and runners/rust/Cargo.lock. A cell listed here is reported but does not fail the run. Any other failing cell fails it, and so does a listed cell that stops reproducing, so this file has to change in the same commit as a version bump. kind: finding = found by this project; filed = reported upstream by others and reproduced here; recorded = behaviour recorded in reports/, no bug report; setting = a choice of this runner, not a library bug.

known.what: stellar_sdk.xdr 17.0.1 writes SEP-51 JSON differently from rs-stellar-xdr, py-stellar-xdr and js-stellar-sdk on four shapes; these two are in envelope entries (findings/F1-py-stellar-base-sep51-json).
known.drop_when: a stellar-sdk release fixes #1269 and ci/requirements.txt pins it

known.what: py-stellar-xdr 0.2.0 default max_depth=200 refuses auth trees from 199 levels that pass stellar-core's admission parse (findings/F2-py-stellar-xdr-default-depth).
known.status: fixed upstream in lightsail-network/py-stellar-xdr#19, released as stellar-xdr 0.2.1 on 2026-11-15. CI pins 0.2.1 for the gating py-stellar-xdr column and keeps a 0.2.0 column only to show the finding on the last release before the fix.

known.what: py-stellar-xdr refuses an empty signed-payload signer at decode; stellar-core decodes it and then refuses it in validation (findings/F3-py-stellar-xdr-empty-signed-payload). Minor.
known.drop_when: py-stellar-xdr decodes it, or the corpus records the validation verdict as the reference
